title: VerifierContract
description: Specifies how a single verification step is executed and what constitutes a pass. Referenced by artifact_contract.success_verifiers and workflow node gates.

name.description: Unique verifier name across the registry. Used as reference key in artifact_contract.

kind.description: Execution mode: deterministic (pure script/binary, exit code checked), reviewer (LLM review agent returns structured verdict), llm_judge (LLM rates artifact on rubric, pass if score >= threshold), external (HTTP callback to external CI/CD system), behavioral (dispatch a cheap-fast agent to exercise an observable surface LIVE — API in staging or UI form via a browser driver — and return an execution-anchored PROVEN/REFUTED/UNVERIFIED verdict; configured by the `observable` block).

observable.description: For kind=behavioral: describes the user- or data-journey surface to exercise live. The checklist is the declared acceptance list (an incomplete checklist is the dominant failure mode in agentic verification — WebTestBench 2603.25226), and metamorphic[] supplies the gold-free oracle (metamorphic REST testing, 2605.28321 / RESTOR 2607.23963).

surface.description: Which observable surface to verify. api = hit a staging HTTP endpoint; ui = drive a browser against a route/form; journey = a multi-step user or data journey spanning surfaces.

target.description: For surface=ui: the route/path under test (e.g. /signup). For surface=api: the staging endpoint path appended to staging_url. Supports env expansion.

staging_url.description: For surface=api: base URL of the staging deployment to probe. Supports env expansion (e.g. ${MO_STAGING_URL}).

method.description: For surface=api: HTTP method to exercise.

checklist.description: Declared acceptance criteria the surface must satisfy. Each item is a human-readable check the agent must confirm live. Declaring these up front closes the incomplete-checklist bottleneck.

expect_status.description: For surface=api: HTTP status codes counted as success.

expect_json_schema.description: For surface=api: optional JSON Schema the response body must validate against (shape/required-keys check).

metamorphic.description: Gold-free oracle: named metamorphic relations the surface must hold under input transformation (e.g. idempotent_repeat, order_invariant, filtered_subset_of_unfiltered). Each is checked by re-exercising the surface with the transformation applied.

budget.description: Hard cost ceiling so a runaway agent cannot burn unbounded tokens/turns (naive computer-use verification = 2.6-7.4M tokens/instance, WebTestBench).

script.description: For kind=deterministic: path to executable script or shell command string. For kind=external: URL template. For kind=reviewer|llm_judge: prompt_ref key. Supports {artifact_path} and {evidence_path} substitutions.

pass_codes.description: Exit codes that count as a pass for kind=deterministic. Default [0].

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock timeout for this verifier. Default 120.

evidence_path_template.description: Template for where to write verifier output (test reports, coverage XML, judge scores). Supports {run_id} and {verifier_name} substitutions.

min_score.description: For kind=llm_judge: minimum score (0.0–1.0) required to pass.

rubric_ref.description: For kind=llm_judge: path to rubric YAML file defining scoring criteria.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this verifier checks.
